# 279_R6FIX.16 — BL-116: signed email-action links consumed on GET (the RH-31 class)

**Date:** 2026-11-16 · **Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-16-action-interstitial` · **Base:** `origin/main` @ `3a840396` · **Spend:** $0 · **Stage:** A only

## Defect

BL-116 (handoff RH-A1-5, verified at `277_R6LOW.1`): `consumeSignedAction` ran on
GET at both mounts — `/api/action/:token` (the minted email path) and `/action/:token`.
Two harms under a mail gateway's link-scanner prefetch:

1. `consumeEmailAction`'s conditional UPDATE marks the single-use token consumed —
   the recipient's real click lands on the 410 page.
2. The `hold` arm additionally calls `holdGate` on GET — a scanner pauses the gate's
   countdown ("Wait for me") with no user intent.

Same defect class as RH-31's magic-link GET consumption (`275_R6WEB.1`); the BL row
explicitly asked for the shared interstitial pattern.

## Change

`apps/api/src/notification-routes.ts`:

- GET on both mounts → `actionInterstitial`: a no-consume confirm page —
  `<form method="post">` back to the same URL, `data-email-action-confirm` on the
  submit (mirroring RH-31's `data-magic-link-confirm` hook). GET verifies nothing and
  touches nothing: no `consumeEmailAction`, no `holdGate`, no DB read.
- POST on both mounts → `consumeSignedAction`, unchanged: HMAC verify + atomic
  single-use consume + `holdGate` for `hold` + 303 to the §4.2 deep link. The
  400 (malformed/bad signature) and 410 (expired/consumed) page contract is
  unchanged — moved verbatim from the GET arm.

`apps/api/src/notification-routes.test.ts`:

- Consume assertions moved to POST (`{ method: "POST" }`) on the existing four arms.
- The minted-URL test keeps the DEF.3/STB.3 F9 contract — the emailed URL answers 200
  (the interstitial), then POST 303 → replay POST 410.
- New pin: two GET prefetches across both mounts leave `gates.held = false`, then the
  confirm POST still consumes exactly once (the scanner-safety regression).

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src/notification-routes.test.ts` — 12/12 (PGlite-backed).
- `@rhema/api` typecheck + lint — see the close commit note.

## Constraints held

Single-use + expiry + HMAC guarantees untouched (the conditional UPDATE is still the
only consume). No auth change. No emissions changed. `mergePolicy: OPERATOR` — never
merged own PR.
